description: This file contains functions and types for managing Docker containers and images, including spawning processes, executing Docker commands, reading container labels and environment variables, ensuring images exist, and managing sandbox containers within a larger application context.

methods.name: createAbortError
methods.description: Creates an Error object with name 'AbortError' indicating an aborted operation.

methods.name: resolveDockerSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments to spawn a Docker process based on runtime environment.

methods.name: execDockerRaw
methods.description: Executes a Docker command with given arguments and options, returning stdout, stderr, and exit code.

methods.name: execDocker
methods.description: Executes a Docker command and returns the output as strings.

methods.name: readDockerContainerLabel
methods.description: Reads a specific label value from a Docker container.

methods.name: readDockerContainerEnvVar
methods.description: Reads a specific environment variable from a Docker container.

methods.name: readDockerPort
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped port number for a Docker container.

methods.name: dockerImageExists
methods.description: Checks if a Docker image exists locally.

methods.name: ensureDockerImage
methods.description: Ensures a Docker image exists locally, pulling or tagging if necessary.

methods.name: dockerContainerState
methods.description: Checks if a Docker container exists and whether it is running.

methods.name: normalizeDockerLimit
methods.description: Normalizes Docker resource limit values to string format.

methods.name: formatUlimitValue
methods.description: Formats ulimit values for Docker container configuration.

methods.name: buildSandboxCreateArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for creating a sandbox Docker container based on configuration.

methods.name: appendCustomBinds
methods.description: Appends bind mount arguments to Docker command arguments.

methods.name: createSandboxContainer
methods.description: Creates and starts a sandbox Docker container with specified configuration.

methods.name: readContainerConfigHash
methods.description: Reads the config hash label from a Docker container.

methods.name: formatSandboxRecreateHint
methods.description: Generates a CLI command to recreate a sandbox based on scope and session key.

methods.name: ensureSandboxContainer
methods.description: Ensures a sandbox container exists and is up-to-date, recreating if configuration has changed.
